text.lead: Hunter Gatherer is a 2016 American drama film written and directed by Josh Locy. The film stars Andre Royo, George Sample III, Kellee Stewart, Ashley Wilkerson, Kevin Jackson, Antonio D. Charity, Celestial, Alexis DeLaRosa, and Jeannetta Arnette. The film was released on November 16, 2016, by The Orchard.
text.cast:
- Andre Royo as Ashley Douglas
- George Sample III as Jeremy Pittman
- Kellee Stewart as Nat
- Ashley Wilkerson as Linda
- Kevin Jackson as Ray
- Antonio D. Charity as Dwayne
- Celestial as Ashley's Mom
- Alexis DeLaRosa as Carlos
- Jeannetta Arnette as Dr. Merton
- Karina Bonnefil as Santa
- Mysti Bluee as Dottie
- Derrick Brooks as Todd
text.release: The film premiered at South by Southwest on March 12, 2016. The film was released on November 16, 2016, by The Orchard.
